quest.title: Taste of Happiness
quest.description: Time to witness the results of the "cooking training" of Arapacati's brothers.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: They're all ready. We can start now.

dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: #Don't you worry, Nara {NICKNAME}, Araphala has prepared the Unrivaled Fresh Fruit for the festival!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Araphala sure moves fast, huh? Let's go check elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Needs more of that "taste of happiness"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's enough!

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Huh? Hmm, Arapacati mentioned that we must make Nara happy with food, so Paimon is right. I'll add less of it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There you go. That should do.

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: The Head Mushroom has been ready for a while now! My super fragrant Head Mushroom...

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: #But I'm not very good at gauging the heat, so please come take a look, Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fire is kinda dangerous to Aranara, so let's go help to control it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will this do?

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Yes! We'll have a supreme delicacy, you can bet on that!

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #The Best Water... But there's nothing's left of it after my practice runs. Would Nara {NICKNAME} mind getting some water from the north of Vanarana for Arapas?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, guess we ought to help out, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back, Arapas! This is the Best Water!

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: #Terrific! I can make the Best Soup so long as I have the Best Water. Nara {NICKNAME} will love it for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: According to the improvement method from Paimon, Aranara finishes the dish under your guidance.\nAfter that, you enjoy the dish with Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's the taste of true-blue gourmet Nara food, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Hmm... While it was Arapacati's suggestion for Nara {NICKNAME} to teach my brothers...

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: Nara dishes... Is this what Nara call "the taste of happiness"?

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: Happiness is fleeing from me...

dialogues.speaker: Arapas
dialogues.text: Vanarana's water is obviously the Best Water, so how did something like this get made from it?

dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: The Unrivaled Fresh Fruit is still delicious, though. Yum.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? You Aranara think it's awful? Paimon thought it was pretty yummy, though...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: I have no idea how "awful" is supposed to taste, but the flavor of this dish... has "impact." You know, like the kind you get from running full-speed into a tree...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... This has gotta be a massive case of culture clash.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Still, it's rude to say that, my brothers. You should be thanking Nara {NICKNAME} instead!

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: *whimper* I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: Don't say "sorry"! Say "Thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: "Brothers"
dialogues.text: #Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #But it's okay as long as Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon enjoy the food! Don't mind them. If our Nara friends are happy, we're happy.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #That said, Nara {NICKNAME} is totally different from Nara Varuna, who told us a lot of things about "{M#brothers}{F#sisters}."

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #But Nara {NICKNAME} is very quiet. Are you feeling unwell?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh, say something, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Arapacati
response.text: #Is that so? I'm glad. Once again, thank you. These petals are from Arapacati and her brothers. They're for you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Arapacati
response.text: We hope the two of you will enjoy more of the "taste of happiness" here in Vanarana!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, no need to worry, Arapacati! {NICKNAME}'s fine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, since the Aranara are making food for us so eagerly during this happy occasion, we should return the favor. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Maybe they'll like some Radish Veggie Soup! Let's show them what Nara cooking's all about!

talks.objective: Give a bowl of Delicious Radish Veggie Soup to Arapacati

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You still have to ask {NICKNAME} to help, or you will end up cooking the same dishes as before.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: My brothers have all done some self-reflection. Festival Utsava is a happy occasion, so Arapacati shouldn't get mad.

dialogues.speaker: Arasaka
dialogues.text: That's right, Arapacati. Don't get mad. Happy occasions should be celebrated with the "taste of happiness"!

dialogues.speaker: Arachatora
dialogues.text: It's time to show off the results of our cooking training!

dialogues.speaker: Araphala
dialogues.text: I have been ready for a long while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay, it's the Festival Utsava Feast! Paimon's been waiting for this!

response.speaker: Arapas
response.text: Water from Vanarana is the best water and makes the best soup. Nara will love it for sure.

response.speaker: Arapacati
response.text: #I shall deliver the "taste of happiness" to Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, and let them "teach" my brothers.

response.speaker: Arapacati
response.text: It's the only way to make food Nara will like. That's how guests should be treated.

response.speaker: Arapacati
response.text: #Would you mind teaching them to cook, Nara {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Best we not get our hopes too high...

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #Would you mind teaching them to cook, Nara {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo! And that's our piping-hot Radish Veggie Soup all ready to go! The Aranara should be done with their dishes too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe later.

dialogues.speaker: Arapacati
dialogues.text: #You must come, Nara {NICKNAME}.
